figures.caption: Tē 83 tô.—Malpighi-sī ê sió-thé, chha-put-to 100 pē khok-tōa : a, b, sòe-jiō-kńg-bé ê sòe-pau ; c, sòe-jiō-kńg ; 1, tōng-meh ; 2, chēng-meh ; 3, si-kiû - chōng - huih - kńg (Blackie and Son).

Tē 84 tô.—Sīn-chōng chiàu tng-hêng chhiat-khui ê tô : C, phê-chit, sī óa gōa-bīn ê chit ; M, chhé-chit, sī khah chhim ê chit ; P, sīn-mng ; U, su-jiō-kńg. Chìn teh chí-bêng jiō teh lâu ê hong-hiòng (Blackie and Son).
